findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp-server" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: audit_url, add_check_in, connect_posthog, get_seo_evidence, get_search_coverage, audit_all_sites, get_audit_report · Private data: connect_posthog · Public sink: compare_audits, share_report · Destructive: add_site, add_check_in, remove_check_in, run_audit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: audit_url, add_check_in, connect_posthog, get_seo_evidence, get_search_coverage, audit_all_sites, get_audit_report · Private data: connect_posthog · Public sink: compare_audits, share_report · Destructive: add_site, add_check_in, remove_check_in, run_audit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
